name: Failed gap: gap outside yesterday's range back inside by 10:30 → toward the prior close
why: A gap that cannot hold outside the prior range traps the overnight buyers/sellers; their exit pushes price back toward the prior close where yesterday's positions sit.

checks.when: !rollwin && abs(gap) >= g && ((open > ph && px < ph) || (open < pl && px > pl))
!rollwin && abs(gap) >= g && ((open > ph && px < ph) || (open < pl && px > pl))
